messages.subject: Best model
parts:
Hello,
I built several ddf models, 
What I am supposed to do if the best model (with lowest AIC) hasn't a good fit ( p value <0.05 when using the ddf.gof function ) ?
  Can I keep this predicted distance value or it is better to built another model? 
Do you have any suggestions for me ?  

Regards

Angela

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Best model
parts:
Angela

Setting aside AIC rank for the moment, making inference based upon a model that does not fit your observed data does not result in defensible estimates.  Your estimates will be open to criticism that you've used a model that is in conflict with the data you observed.

More reliable estimates are derived from employing models that fit your distance sampling data.
